title: Cloud Security
shortDescription: Secure cloud environments, workloads and sensitive data across modern infrastructure.
fullDescription: Comprehensive security posture management (CSPM) and cloud workload protection (CWPP) across multi-cloud clusters (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). SPECTRE DEFEND enforces zero-trust IAM least-privilege policies, monitors Kubernetes runtime deviations, and detects infrastructure-as-code configuration drifts before production deployments.
features: Multi-Cloud CSPM, CWPP & CIEM Continuous Governance
Kubernetes & Container Runtime Defense with eBPF
seoTitle: Multi-Cloud Security & Kubernetes Workload Protection | SPECTRE DEFEND
seoDescription: Full-stack cloud security posture management and runtime container isolation across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
whatIs: SPECTRE DEFEND Cloud Security is an enterprise-grade cloud native application protection platform (CNAPP) unifying CSPM, CWPP, and CIEM across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters.
howItWorks:
1. Agentless Multi-Cloud Discovery: API connectors scan cloud assets, IAM permissions, and storage buckets in minutes.
2. Infrastructure-as-Code Auditing: Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi templates are scanned in CI/CD pipelines.
3. Runtime Container Guard: Kernel-level monitors isolate compromised container pods in Kubernetes namespaces.
4. Automated Remediation: Misconfigured cloud resources and exposed S3/storage buckets are remediated automatically.
whyItMatters: Over 80% of enterprise cloud breaches stem from misconfigured IAM permissions, publicly exposed cloud buckets, or orphaned API keys. SPECTRE DEFEND establishes mathematical least-privilege access and eliminates configuration drift.
whoItIsFor: SaaS providers, cloud-native technology companies, fintechs, and enterprises migrating monolithic workloads into cloud and container environments.
deliverables: Multi-Cloud CSPM Compliance & Security Benchmark Reports
Real-Time Cloud Inventory & Asset Dependency Graph

faqs.question: Does cloud security require deploying agents onto all our virtual machines?
faqs.answer: No. SPECTRE DEFEND offers 100% agentless posture management via read-only cloud APIs. Optional lightweight daemonsets are available for deep Kubernetes runtime protection.

faqs.question: Which compliance standards does the CSPM engine audit against?
faqs.answer: SPECTRE DEFEND continuously audits against SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, PCI-DSS 4.0, and HIPAA regulations.
